title: Affine raw module-cohomology classes have stage representatives after comparison
statement: Under the scheme, coefficient, cofiltered-index, affine-transition, qcqs, and limiting-cone assumptions of [def-sbc-module-higher-image-transitions], let U be an affine etale object over S [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. For each raw degree-q class z in the derived-Hom presheaf of the limit with coefficient c.pt^*G, there is a stage i and a raw class t at that stage whose image under the canonical raw-to-higher-image section comparison, followed by higherDirectImageOverMap(c_i), equals the raw-to-higher-image section associated to z. The raw presheaves use the free module sheaf on U and single complexes in [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. This is only an assertion about raw classes on affine objects; it says nothing about arbitrary higher-image sections or sheaf colimits.

proof.text: Apply nonempty_higherDirectImageRaw_complex_presentation to obtain the presentation of the prescribed raw cocone in integer degree q. EtaleComplexCohomologyPresentation.isColimit eliminates its existential witnesses and applies nonempty_isColimit_etale_complex_cohomology, giving the colimit certificate. Thus complex continuity remains a dependency of this step.

The forgetful functor on abelian groups preserves the filtered colimit, using preservesFilteredColimitsOfSize_shrink. Concrete.isColimit_exists_rep gives a stage and a class. Unop the stage and identify its cocone leg with higherDirectImageRawOverPullback using higherDirectImageRawOverPullbackHom_apply.

Apply higherDirectImageRawOverPullback_comparison to the cone leg. Apply the limit comparison component to the raw representative equality, and compose with the symmetric pullback comparison equality. This gives the unchanged section equality.

theorem exists_higher_image_raw_affine_image_rep
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℤ)
    {I : Type u} [Category.{u} I] [IsCofiltered I] (D : I ⥤ Over W)
    [∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f).left]
    [∀ i, QuasiCompact ((D.obj i).hom ≫ k)]
    [∀ i, QuasiSeparated ((D.obj i).hom ≫ k)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget W).mapCone c))
    [QuasiCompact (c.pt.hom ≫ k)] [QuasiSeparated (c.pt.hom ≫ k)]
    (U : S.Etale) [IsAffine U.left]
    (z : (higherDirectImageRawOverPresheaf Λ k G q c.pt).obj (op U)) :
    ∃ (i : I)
      (t : (higherDirectImageRawOverPresheaf Λ k G q (D.obj i)).obj (op U)),
      ((higherDirectImageOverMap Λ k G q (c.π.app i)).hom.app (op U))
        ((higherDirectImageRawOverComparison Λ k G q (D.obj i)).app (op U) t) =
      (higherDirectImageRawOverComparison Λ k G q c.pt).app (op U) z
